Container.Name: FIHAS-Bot
Container.Overview:
Discord bot that watches an X/Twitter account (default @F_I_H_A_S) and posts an fxtwitter.com link to a channel whenever it tweets, pinging whoever you configure.
Click the container icon and choose WebUI to open a step-by-step setup wizard — it lists your servers, channels and roles, tests the feed sources, and previews the message. Everything is also controllable from Discord with /fihas slash commands.
The setup UI is password protected. Set "Setup UI Password" below, or leave it blank and a password is generated and printed in the container log on first start.
Config persists in /config so it survives updates and restarts.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot -> Reset Token). Keep this secret.

Config.Name: Discord Application ID
Config.Description: Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal (General Information).

Config.Name: Discord Server ID
Config.Description: Your server ID. Strongly recommended: slash commands register instantly instead of taking up to an hour.

Config.Name: Setup UI Password
Config.Description: Password for the setup wizard WebUI. Leave blank to have one generated and printed in the container log on first start.

Config.Name: Discord Channel ID
Config.Description: Optional. Channel to post in. You can also set this later with /fihas channel set.

Config.Name: Ping Role IDs
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated role IDs to ping on a new post. Also settable with /fihas ping add.

Config.Name: Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to check for new posts. Minimum 30.

Config.Name: RSS Feed URLs
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated RSS feeds tried in order. Leave blank to use built-in defaults. A self-hosted RSSHub is by far the most reliable option.

Config.Name: X API Bearer Token
Config.Description: Optional. Only works on a paid X API plan (Basic or higher); the free tier cannot read timelines. When set, it is tried before RSS.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Persistent config and the list of already-posted tweet IDs.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Setup wizard and dashboard. Also serves an unauthenticated /healthz endpoint used for the container health check.
